evidence.quoted_text:
def claim_run_dir(self):
        base = Path(self.args.record_dir)
        resolved = base.resolve()
        root = self.root.resolve()
        require(resolved != root and root not in resolved.parents,
                "--record-dir must be outside the deployment checkout")
        base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
                + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6])
        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: The run directory is recovery evidence (prior SHA, triggers), but `claim_run_dir` creates a new entry under `record_dir` with only `mkdir`. Neither this creation path nor the cited durable receipt write persists the record base directory entry (or the new base's parent entry if `parents=True` creates it). A power loss can therefore leave the admission/host-hold in place while dropping the entire run directory. This is a concrete durability defect in existing recovery behavior; sync the record base after creating the run directory and fail closed if that sync fails.
